description:
What really happened behind closed hospital doors during COVID-19? Why were patients isolated from their loved ones, denied access to alternative treatments, and subjected to controversial hospital protocols? And how many lives might have been saved if patients and families had been given a greater voice in their care?Show more These are among the disturbing questions explored in Bad Medicine, a new documentary from acclaimed filmmaker Mikki Willis, creator of Plandemic.
Through the stories of grieving families and an examination of COVID-era hospital policies, the film investigates the use of remdesivir, mechanical ventilation, restrictions on family visitation, and the institutional decisions that shaped patient care during the pandemic.
But Bad Medicine goes further. The filmmakers examine what they describe as a troubling pattern of fear, manipulation, censorship, and institutional control, raising profound questions about the power of government, pharmaceutical interests, and medical institutions during a public health emergency.
This week on VSRF Live, we're delighted to welcome back Livio Sanchez as guest host! Livio, who worked on the production of Bad Medicine, reunites with Mikki Willis for a revealing behind-the-scenes conversation about the making of the film, the evidence it presents, and the heartbreaking stories of families who continue to demand answers and accountability.
For those families, the pandemic may be over, but the fight for truth and justice is far from finished.
What will it take to uncover the truth, hold institutions accountable, and ensure that patients and families never again face such circumstances?
